regime_context: China A-shares shows a one-narrative dominant tape with Banks as the sole eligible leader; the absolute-trend gate did NOT hold on this market's history, so drawdown control edge should be treated as experimental here. Momentum rank is display-only focus, and the track record direction accuracy is below coin-flip, so I hold few and modest leans.
emerging_watch: Defense & Aerospace (512660.SS) may be forming leadership; it is rank 2 with score 0.525 but ineligible and low durability (0.39). I am watching for it to clear eligibility with durability above 0.5 and breadth above 0.5 while Banks' score rolls over — that combination would retire this watch.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks is the only theme that is both eligible and the confirmed leader, with strong durability (0.74), trend health, and broad participation (breadth 0.833). The crowding flag is a size-down caution, not a fade signal, and the one-narrative structure means leadership is concentrated but unconfirmed as a fresh buy. I would lean with the confirmed leader only, respecting that the trend gate has no validated drawdown control here.
theses.dissent: Banks is crowded and extended; in this mean-reverting tape the leader is vulnerable to sharp shake-outs, and the trend gate has historically not reduced drawdown on China A-shares.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS lags CSI 300 by 5% before the check-by date

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Pharma & CXO is eligible but much weaker than Banks on score (0.375) and durability (0.57, below the 0.74 leader), and is also crowded. The spread between eligible leaders is wide and rotation breadth is very narrow, so there is no confirmed handoff into a new leader. I would not chase this as a challenger.
theses.dissent: Pharma & CXO could be an early challenger if Banks mean-reverts and funds rotate into the second-highest-scored eligible theme, giving it relative strength off a low base.

falsifier.text: 159992.SZ outperforms 512800.SS by 5% before the check-by date
